reason: Disabling hash join v2 support for non-GA join types changes both planner path selection and executor join-version gating in core join code. Join algorithm availability is high-blast-radius: it can alter physical plans, fallback behavior, and runtime correctness/performance across many queries. The touched files are central (`pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go`, `pkg/executor/join/joinversion/join_version.go`), and the broad plan/integration test updates suggest visible semantic changes rather than a local fix.
